part.name: Rounded-end blind-bore mounting arm
part.description: A single-piece elongated mechanical body comprising a load-carrying rectangular spine, a profiled distal mounting nose with a blind longitudinal bore, an underside access or clearance pocket, and an enlarged rounded rear housing or abutment.
part.symmetry_note: The part has no complete global symmetry. The broad top and side geometry is approximately prismatic along the length, but the underside pocket, blind bore, distal corner treatment, and asymmetric rear-to-spine shoulder break symmetry.

Section.name: Main load spine
Section.function intent: Connect the enlarged rear body to the distal mounting interface and provide the principal load path through the part.
Section.physical behavior: The deep, mostly solid rectangular section resists bending and torsion. Broad planar faces provide section depth, while the long edge chamfers remove sharp edges and reduce local stress concentration.
Section.geometry: A long rectangular-prismatic body extending from the enlarged rear section toward the distal end. It has a broad flat top, two principal side faces, a flat lower face, and narrow diagonal bands along the front upper and lower edges.
Section.location: Central and longitudinal portion of the part, approximately STEP x=100 to x=290, connecting the rear housing to the distal nose.

major_faces.name: Continuous top deck
major_faces.description: Large planar upper surface spanning most of the part length and forming the primary top datum.

major_faces.name: Upper front edge chamfer
major_faces.description: Long diagonal planar band connecting the top deck to the principal front side.

major_faces.name: Principal front side
major_faces.description: Large vertical planar side face extending along the spine and bounded by the longitudinal edge treatments.

major_faces.name: Lower front edge chamfer
major_faces.description: Long diagonal planar band joining the principal front side to the lower surface.

major_faces.name: Spine lower face
major_faces.description: Broad planar underside of the elongated spine, locally interrupted by the access pocket region.

major_faces.name: Principal rear side
major_faces.description: Large vertical planar rear side of the spine, extending from the rear shoulder toward the rounded distal corner.

Section.name: Distal mounting nose
features included: profile transition from spine to nose
Section.function intent: Provide a compact terminal interface for receiving a pin, shaft, rod, or mating cylindrical component while presenting a protected and rounded external end.
Section.physical behavior: The nose surrounds and supports the bore entrance, carrying radial loads from a mating cylindrical component into the main spine. Rounded and conical transition patches reduce sharp-edge damage and distribute stress around the terminal region.
Section.geometry: A profiled end block at the narrow end of the part. It has a planar terminal face containing a circular opening, a short planar side facet, large and small vertical cylindrical corner rounds, and a lower end chamfer.
Section.location: Extreme distal end of the part, approximately STEP x=233 to x=300.

major_faces.name: Front transition cylinder
major_faces.description: Large-radius cylindrical vertical patch transitioning the spine side into the distal nose profile.

major_faces.name: Distal side facet
major_faces.description: Narrow planar side face between the large transition round and the terminal end treatment.

major_faces.name: Terminal fine corner fillet
major_faces.description: Small-radius vertical cylindrical band softening the junction between the distal side facet and end face.

major_faces.name: Terminal mounting face
major_faces.description: Planar end face containing the circular entrance to the longitudinal blind bore.

major_faces.name: Rear terminal corner round
major_faces.description: Large vertical cylindrical round joining the terminal face to the principal rear side.

major_faces.name: Lower terminal chamfer
major_faces.description: Diagonal planar band between the terminal face, lower face, and adjacent rounded corner.

Section.name: Blind longitudinal bore
Section.function intent: Receive and radially locate a cylindrical mating member, with the blind end establishing a controlled insertion limit.
Section.physical behavior: The cylindrical wall reacts radial bearing loads and constrains transverse translation of an inserted member. The planar blind floor reacts axial insertion force and prevents the member from passing completely through the part.
Section.geometry: A large circular cylindrical cavity running longitudinally inward from the distal end face and terminating at a flat circular blind floor near the rear end of the spine.
Section.location: Internal to the spine and distal nose, approximately along STEP x=100 to x=300 and centered near y=270, z=-400.

major_faces.name: Bore cylindrical wall
major_faces.description: Long internal cylindrical surface forming the principal radial locating interface for a mating pin or shaft.

major_faces.name: Bore blind floor
major_faces.description: Circular planar end surface that closes the bore and provides an axial insertion stop.

Section.name: Underside access pocket
Section.function intent: Provide local clearance or tool access beneath the spine and potentially expose or relieve the region near the longitudinal bore.
Section.physical behavior: The recess removes material from a limited central zone while retaining surrounding walls that bridge loads around the opening. Its planar boundaries provide predictable clearance and avoid interference with a mating component.
Section.geometry: A compact, generally rectangular recessed region on the underside or lower side of the spine. The pocket has two opposed longitudinal walls, an internal planar ceiling, a lower ledge or floor patch, and a transverse closure wall.
Section.location: Central underside of the spine, approximately STEP x=125 to x=168 and y=230 to y=280.

major_faces.name: Pocket lower ledge
major_faces.description: Planar horizontal patch forming the lower or deeper stepped boundary of the access recess.

major_faces.name: Pocket first side wall
major_faces.description: Planar longitudinal wall on one side of the rectangular recess.

major_faces.name: Pocket transverse end wall
major_faces.description: Planar wall closing the inner end of the recess and joining the two opposed side walls.

major_faces.name: Pocket internal ceiling
major_faces.description: Broad planar internal surface defining the upper boundary of the pocket.

major_faces.name: Pocket second side wall
major_faces.description: Planar wall opposite the first side wall, completing the principal rectangular pocket boundary.

Section.name: Enlarged rounded rear housing
Section.function intent: Provide an enlarged abutment, housing, grip, or load-distribution region at the rear of the part while avoiding exposed sharp corners.
Section.physical behavior: The increased cross-section spreads loads entering or leaving the spine and supplies a broad contact envelope. Large cylindrical and spherical blends reduce impact sensitivity and stress concentration at the external corners.
Section.geometry: A thick rounded rectangular end body attached to the rear of the narrow spine. It combines planar side and end facets with large-radius cylindrical lower and side bands, a spherical corner patch, and smaller edge fillets.
Section.location: Enlarged rear end of the part, approximately STEP x=0 to x=100.

major_faces.name: Rear-to-spine shoulder
major_faces.description: Planar shoulder at the junction where the enlarged rear body steps into the narrower spine.

major_faces.name: Upper rear edge fillet
major_faces.description: Small-radius cylindrical band rounding the upper edge near the shoulder side of the rear housing.

major_faces.name: Rear housing side facet
major_faces.description: Broad planar exterior face forming one principal side of the enlarged rear body.

major_faces.name: Lower rear edge fillet
major_faces.description: Small cylindrical band connecting the rear side facet to the lower planar surface.

major_faces.name: Rear housing lower facet
major_faces.description: Broad planar lower surface of the enlarged housing between its rounded perimeter bands.

major_faces.name: Shoulder-side lower fillet
major_faces.description: Small-radius cylindrical transition along the lower edge adjacent to the rear-to-spine shoulder.

major_faces.name: Rear housing front transition round
major_faces.description: Large vertical cylindrical patch blending a planar side region into the shoulder side of the enlarged housing.

major_faces.name: Rear housing front facet
major_faces.description: Rectangular planar exterior facet between two large rounded vertical corners.

major_faces.name: Front outer vertical round
major_faces.description: Large-radius cylindrical surface forming a rounded vertical corner at the outer end of the housing.

major_faces.name: Rear terminal end facet
major_faces.description: Planar end wall at the extreme enlarged end of the part.

major_faces.name: Opposite outer vertical round
major_faces.description: Large-radius cylindrical patch forming the second major vertical corner of the enlarged end.

major_faces.name: Outer lower longitudinal round
major_faces.description: Large cylindrical lower-edge surface running along the outer side of the rear housing.

major_faces.name: Front lower transverse round
major_faces.description: Large cylindrical band connecting the front facet to the lower region of the rear housing.

major_faces.name: Large lower corner sphere
major_faces.description: Spherical corner patch blending the large vertical and lower cylindrical rounds at the outer corner.
